meta.title: Freight charges only become available at three or more line items
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen for a pricing stage.
Provide the required event title for a create test.
Configure the event with an RFQ pricing stage.
Apply the pricing template before adding line items.
Create the two-line-item setup required by the case.
Verify freight_charges is absent from the price-field menu at two line items.
Add the third line item that should cross the availability threshold.
Reopen the price-field menu and verify freight_charges is now present.
